facts.1. First contracted caravan is scheduled: 30; the caravan arrived on schedule. By 07:45 the first inspection findings reported that submitted papers, presented identities, declared cargo class, and visible load were mutually consistent. No hold was requested; routine inspection and custody work continue.
facts.2. Sword Manor Commander Wei Jian reques: 00 command council; it convened at 08:00 under Wei Jian's standing authority. Its provisional recommendation is to honor existing escort obligations and avoid fresh trainee reallocation until a House principal gives further direction. The recommendation binds neither Tang Wei nor House Tang.
facts.adjacent_security: Duan Jin and Shen Rui remain on protective duty near the family-hall approaches; no immediate alarm is active
available_reports_already_delivered: Kanyou intelligence case opened with Tang Ling; inner contents known to Tang Wei and Tang Ling
Main Gate first inspection findings delivered to Tang Wei
Sword Manor opening council note and provisional recommendations delivered to Tang Wei
facts.current_decision: At 08:30 Tang Wei has told his family that he intends to seek Qin military service, hopes for Duke Hyou's army if a real assignment path exists, and intends to take Tang Kai so Kai can see battle. He has not yet chosen a concrete enlistment route, commander request, retinue arrangement, or final Kai safety boundary.
facts.forbidden_inference: The announced intentions do not themselves create Qin enlistment, commander assignment, deployment, transfer of House Tang assets, movement of Tang Kai, or a final battlefield placement decision.
facts.immediate_pressure: Kanyou remains politically uncertain; the caravan is proceeding routinely; Sword Manor has preserved its present obligations; Tang Wei's proposed Qin service would become a public affiliation if accepted; Tang Kai is four and not eligible for protected battlefield service until age ten.
facts.participants: Tang Wei, Tang Zhu, Tang Ling, Tang Kai
